observations: Sandboxed Google Chrome 151 headless process exited with SIGABRT before Playwright could attach over CDP.
A narrowly scoped elevated retry was rejected because the active global boundary forbids script-launching system Chrome.
No service worker, InnerTube request, or timedtext request was observed; extension side-loading itself was not reached or verified.

error.name: Error
error.message: Playwright target closed during browser launch; debug output recorded process exit signal SIGABRT before CDP attachment.

probe.conclusion: Inconclusive for MV3 transport. The test environment blocked system-Chrome automation before extension loading.
